concept: A wedding planner; style finder, budget planner and enquiry.
look: romantic luminous wedding photography, 50mm, soft light

shots.title: Hero
shots.prompt: Event photograph: a wedding stage with an arch of white flowers and candles in a ballroom, atmospheric light, wide composition, space for a headline. Every person in the picture is a clearly different individual (age, build, skin tone, hair and clothing all vary) so no face is repeated; faces may be turned away or out of frame. Overall look: romantic luminous wedding photography, 50mm, soft light; colour palette of ivory, gold, blush, deep green. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
